text: Sam (People Ops): idea: a low-friction sticker vending station for micro-spot-awards in the lobby. people can grab a sticker when they receive kudos from a peer. quick, non-cash, visible. thoughts? :sparkles: Rico (Office Ops): love it. small freestanding dispenser? we have a tabletop dispenser vendor. will need refill plan. Asha (Finance): cost check 00 refills x $0.30/sticker = $120 plus dispenser $45. keep under GL 4102. Marta (Legal): privacy: make sure we don't collect addresses. just a QR to /recognize that links the award to the recipient. sticker-bot: Reminder  please log any spot-awards via /recognize and tag #sticker-vend for payroll exports. Sam (People Ops): good call. plan: dispenser + 500 stickers, sign with QR to quick form. one sticker per recognized event. Rico (Office Ops): volunteers to refill weekly? I can do it for first month. also will bolt dispenser to kiosk stand. Asha (Finance): confirm expense path: if under $500 can use petty cash; upload receipts. Sam (People Ops): wording for sign: "Got kudos? Scan QR, submit quick shoutout, take one sticker. One sticker per recognition. Stickers are symbolic and non-cash." Marta (Legal): include opt-out language on form: "You may decline physical tokens; choose digital only." sticker-bot: Note  entries tagged #sticker-vend included in monthly recognition CSV. Sam (People Ops): action items: Rico order dispenser and 500 stickers; Asha confirm petty route; Marta review QR form privacy blurb; I'll draft sign and post in #people-ops. Rico (Office Ops): placing order today. ETA 5 business days. Sam (People Ops): perfect. small pilot for June 3-30. low overhead, visible culture win. :tada:
